learner_operation: Locate a missing theorem fragment, identify its mathematical role, and recall the corresponding column-space, null-space, rank or nullity fact for a real invertible square matrix before selecting one of five choices.

fixed_features.feature: Square real matrix, n positive, complete four-clause theorem and one blank
fixed_features.justification: Lesson tutorial 17592186125780 and canonical e-9962 characterize precisely this theorem. Rectangular matrices or computational tasks would change the skill.

fixed_features.feature: One correct radio choice and five options
fixed_features.justification: All 16 captured practice questions use this response contract. Known ambiguous banks are explicitly corrected.

fixed_features.feature: Invertibility and constants n/0 at their semantic locations
fixed_features.justification: These are the theorem facts to recognize, not arbitrary qualifying labels. The sole adjective bank intentionally recalls invertibility; changing it would require new hypotheses beyond this task.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any displayed fragment, including canonical dim Null(A).
answer_roles.observed: All 11 targets in fresh sampling and 13 complete bank/target constructions. Actual five-record batch has five distinct targets.

answer_roles.role: Correct mathematical option within a recognizable complete bank
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Hold bank fixed and move blank among four compatible locations; correct expression must follow.
answer_roles.observed: Four different correct expressions per mathematical bank survive delivery. Relevant controlled pairs alter response, rendered blank and solution; all options tested by native grader.

answer_roles.role: Answer position and irrelevant presentation order
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Shuffle all five options independently of target.
answer_roles.observed: All five positions in fresh sample; batch positions 3,2,4,1,3. Thirteen order counterfactuals preserve answers and solutions.

coverage.result: 13 constructions covering 11 target roles; one true choice each.

coverage.case: Fresh public sampler after inventory, deduplication and difficulty filtering
coverage.result: 33 input records, 20 duplicate removals, 13 accepted; every bank/target pair retained.
Five accepted, no duplicates; distinct targets, no universal constant answer or position. Singleton profiles are not treated as independently balanced.

counterfactuals.change: Within each mathematical bank move the blank through compatible theorem locations, holding full theorem and option values fixed.
counterfactuals.expected: Correct expression changes; prompt/solution and grader track the changed target.
counterfactuals.observed: Nine adjacent relevant pairs; different keys and visible blank locations, independently checked completed solutions. All pair members rendered in render-all; native grader accepts new key and rejects old expression where present.
counterfactuals.justification: Blank location is answer-bearing evidence for this recognition task.

counterfactuals.change: Change only option-order seed for every supported construction.
counterfactuals.expected: Prompt, explanation and mathematical response preserved; selected UI position may change.
counterfactuals.observed: 13 preserved keys/prompts/solutions, all choices tested against native grader. First pair rendered before/after as records 1 and 19.
counterfactuals.justification: Option order is incidental to the theorem fact.

stages_examined: Generator distinct-target sampling and compatible-bank selection; no rejection/resampling branch
Actual publisher normalization, KP validation, inventory and within-batch deduplication
Captured inventory attribution and practice eligibility
Selection weights, deterministic within-band selection, prior-history/reservation exclusion scenarios
delivery.result: All 13 independently constructed bank/target cases remain reachable after shared delivery on fresh seeds; exact batch retains all five. Selection scenarios show no target-dependent filter with positive easy weight, while unconfigured fallback and histories can narrow a finite pool. No live database operation.

limitations: Finite 11 target roles support theorem recognition; option shuffles and bank variants do not create new semantic targets.
Source canonical answer bank absent; canonical expression is solution-backed and radio extension explicitly identified.
Selection policy/history and future generated entity IDs are unavailable; selection conclusions are rule-level and explicit-scenario only.
No finite audit establishes absence of every shortcut. Conditional singleton batch groups are described without claiming statistical evidence.
